milestones.title: Wrap version 3 and wrap@3 are reserved, and readers refuse them as not supported yet
The Cyber Centre's advice above Protected B is requested through your organization's sponsor

remediation: The post-quantum cell key wrap uses ML-KEM-768 with P-256, which ITSP.40.111 lists up to Protected B. Above that, ask the Cyber Centre for advice through your organization's sponsor, then build wrap version 3 (ML-KEM-1024 with P-384, feature wrap@3). Until then readers refuse version 3 as not supported yet.
title: ML-KEM-768 is listed only up to Protected B
